MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 12

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

3. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 8

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 8

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 13

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 10

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
